text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Jordanian press on Sunday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Prime Minister Abdul-Salam al-Majali to discuss the terms of dialogue with the Islamist dominated opposition which decided to boycott parliamentary elections due next November.

- Will the dialogue between the opposition parties and the government take place on Sunday after it was put forward from Saturday; a smaller committee formed by the parties to lay the basis of dialogue to ensure fairnesss of the elections. A statement to be issued by prominent non-party activists boycotting the elections.
- Over 2.8 million voters on the electoral list.
- The government sets new rules for licensing taxis which raises capital requirements.
- Jordanians convicted in a bank fraud in the United States have become fugitives.
